blessings.name: Ripper
blessings.effect: When damaging enemies on their half, gains 20% crit rate and 20% crit damage.
blessings.why: A crit-oriented blessing that rewards aggressive, frontline-pushing heroes. The bonus only activates when your heroes are on the enemy's half of the field, so it is unreliable for pure backline carries. At max level it grants 40% crit rate and 60% crit dmg, which compounds strongly with crit-specific buffs. Weaker than Mask of Sorrow overall because it provides no attack cadence boost, but it is the best option for players when running a melee-heavy frontline roster.
tips: Prioritize melee or frontline heroes who naturally push into the enemy half - Heracles, Dionysus, Nezha.
Stack crit rate and crit dmg buffs between waves. The blessing's bonus is multiplicative with all of them.
DEF Ignore on CRIT is extremely high value here - your crit rate will often be above 80%, making every hit a full-penetration strike.
Avoid pure backline archers or mages as your primary carries. They spend most of the fight on your own half.
upgrades: Unlocked at Total Genre Level 2: When damaging enemies on their half, gains 30% crit rate and 40% crit damage.
Unlocked at Total Genre Level 5: When damaging enemies on their half, gains 40% crit rate and 60% crit damage.

blessings.name: Mask of Sorrow
blessings.effect: Invalidates the middle backline ally's attacks, but empowers other allies with 100% normal attack speed.
blessings.why: The attack speed bonus is multiplicative with all the normal-attack buffs available between waves. The invalidated slot becomes a passive-only support position - heroes like Dionysus or Caishen still apply all their passive effects while their normal attacks are suppressed.
tips: Always place a passive-utility hero in the middle backline slot.
Build every buff selection around normal attack speed and crit.
Skill cooldown reduction compounds with the speed bonus to allow more rotations per fight.
upgrades: Unlocked at Total Genre Level 2: Invalidates the middle backline allys's attacks, but empowers other allies with 100% attack speed and reduced skill cooldowns.
Unlocked at Total Genre Level 5: Invalidates the middle backline ally's attacks, but empowers other allies with 100% attack speed and reduced skill cooldowns.

blessings.name: Divine Nectar
blessings.effect: All Allies gain additional 30 energy each second and Damage dealt by non-ultimate skills is reduced by 50%.
blessings.why: If your roster relies heavily on ultimate skills for damage and you have heroes who benefit from sustained energy generation. The energy-per-second gain enables more frequent ultimates, but the non-ultimate skill damage reduction hurts teams that use skill-based carries.
tips: Pair with ultimate-focused heroes and energy-acceleration supports.
Avoid if your primary damage sources are non-ultimate skills.
Select ultimate damage buffs and energy buffs between waves instead of attack speed.
upgrades: Unlocked at Total Genre Level 2: All Allies gain additional 50 energy each second and Damage dealt by non-ultimate skills is reduced by 50%.
Unlocked at Total Genre Level 5: All Allies gain additional 75 energy each second and Damage dealt by non-ultimate skills is reduced by 50%. Ultimate Damage is increased by an additional 50%.

blessings.name: Megafungus
blessings.effect: The ally deity with the highest attack grows in size and gains 20% of the Energy generated by other deployed deities.
blessings.why: Skadi becomes the Megafungus carrier because she naturally has the highest ATK. At level 5 she inherits 50% of every ally's ATK and HP, meaning buffing supports' ATK directly scales her damage. Poseidon's crowd control gives Skadi consistent windows to cast and Caishen plus Dionysus feed energy and ATK buffs to the whole team.
tips: Buff all heroes' ATK, not just Skadi. Every point of ATK on supports transfers 50% to her.
Prioritize energy buffs so Skadi and Poseidon reach their ultimates faster.
Starting Energy (+1000) is extremely valuable - take it whenever it appears.
Shield on Ultimate pairs with Energy Regen on Shield for a strong energy loop.
upgrades: Unlocked at Total Genre Level 2: The ally deity with the highest attack grows in size and gains immunity to crowd control. That deity also gains 20% of the Energy generated by other deployed allies and 20% of their ATK and HP.

Unlocked at Total Genre Level 5: The ally deity with the highest attack grows in size and gains immunity to crowd control. That deity also gains 20% of the Energy generated by other deployed allies and 50% of their ATK and HP.
